fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: Also the name of its payment gateway, which apps pass to start a payment, e.g. Jenga Card.

fields.label: Currencies
fields.description: Currencies this merchant takes by card, e.g. KES, USD. A payment in any other currency is refused before it starts.

fields.label: Payment Gateway
fields.description: Created when this account is saved, switched off. Switch it on there once Test Connection succeeds.

fields.label: Signing Private Key
fields.description: PEM private key whose public key is registered with Jenga. Needed only when the merchant is in secure mode; every order is then signed.

fields.label: Payment Notification (IPN)
fields.description: Jenga's server confirms each card payment by posting to the Notification Address with this username and password. Register both in the JengaHQ portal (Settings, IPN). The payer's own browser is never taken as proof.

fields.label: Notification Address
fields.description: Register this in the JengaHQ portal. Filled in when the account is saved.

fields.label: Ask Jenga for Payment Status
fields.description: Also ask Jenga's Transaction Details API about open card payments. Switch on only after a sandbox card payment shows that it answers for card checkouts.

fields.label: Product Description
fields.description: Shown on Jenga's page, followed by the payment reference.

fields.label: Payer Email When Unknown
fields.description: Jenga requires an email; used when the app gives none.

fields.label: Public Site Address
fields.description: The public https address of this site that the provider can reach, with no path, e.g. https://pay.redcross.or.ke. Blank: the site's own address.

fields.label: Authentication URL
fields.description: Blank: Jenga's own for the environment. Set only if Jenga gives you another.

fields.label: Checkout URL
fields.description: Blank: Jenga's own for the environment (production: https://v3.jengapgw.io/processPayment).
